title: Public-start end-to-end acceptance

any: local tests cannot prove the accepted outcome

requires.when: one implementation fragment supplies the complete runnable outcome

skill_calls.when: a public-start journey must be executed
E2E and related evidence are ready to join

nodes.obligation: Execute the smallest public-start journey and required negative or recovery trajectory.

tests.evidence: the complete outcome is observable without seeded internal state unless explicitly scoped

tests.when: the changed journey has a material failure or resume path
tests.evidence: failure is observable and recovery preserves required state

workline_policy: Prefer an independent validation workline or graph batch when acceptance must remain independent from implementers.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE when a lower test seam proves the complete outcome and no cross-runtime or journey risk remains.
repair: E2E failure reopens the earliest responsible fragment and only consumers whose named inputs depend on it.
